name: Instant Replay
description: Capture your best completions and new bests with zero FPS loss! GPU hardware-accelerated Instant Replay featuring AV1, HEVC, H.264, Adaptive VBR, multi-track studio audio, mic device picker, and real-time file size estimator.

enabled.name: Background Replay Active
enabled.description: Keep instant replay active in background

duration.name: Replay Duration (Seconds)
duration.description: How many last seconds of gameplay to save (e.g. 30s, 60s = 1m, 120s = 2m, 300s = 5m, up to 3600s = 1h)

codec.name: Video Codec
codec.description: Video encoding format: av1, hevc, h264, or custom

hardware-accel.name: Hardware Acceleration (GPU)
hardware-accel.description: Automatically use GPU hardware encoder (NVIDIA NVENC, AMD AMF, Intel QuickSync) based on your graphics card. Falls back to CPU software encoding if disabled.

custom-codec.name: Custom Codec Name
custom-codec.description: Custom codec for your GPU/CPU (e.g. av1_nvenc, hevc_nvenc, h264_nvenc, amf_av1, qsv_av1, software_h264)

fps.name: Frame Rate (FPS)
fps.description: Target video frame rate (30 to 240 FPS; UI presets: 60, 120, 240)

rate-control.name: Rate Control Mode
rate-control.description: Adaptive VBR dynamically scales bitrate based on scene motion complexity. CBR is fixed. CQ targets constant visual quality.

bitrate.name: Target Bitrate (Mbps)
bitrate.description: Average target bitrate in Megabits per second (5 - 250 Mbps)

max-bitrate.name: Max Peak Bitrate (Mbps)
max-bitrate.description: Maximum peak bitrate for high-speed gameplay during Adaptive VBR (10 - 300 Mbps)

quality-level.name: Quality Factor (CQ)
quality-level.description: Constant quality factor from 20 (low) to 100 (near lossless)

split-audio.name: Separate Audio Tracks
split-audio.description: Record Game Audio and Microphone into TWO SEPARATE audio tracks in MP4 (for DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, Vegas)

save-folder.name: Save Directory Path
save-folder.description: Custom folder path to save replay MP4 videos (leave empty for default Videos/Geometry Dash)

temp-folder.name: Temp Buffer Directory
temp-folder.description: Custom folder path for rolling 30s buffer segments (leave empty for system TEMP folder)

show-notification.name: Show Toast Notification
show-notification.description: Show floating notification banner when replay is saved

save-replay.name: Save Instant Replay
save-replay.description: Save the last minutes of gameplay to an MP4 video file (F6 default)

toggle-replay.name: Toggle Instant Replay
toggle-replay.description: Turn background replay on or off (Ctrl+F6 default)

open-menu.name: Open Instant Replay Menu
open-menu.description: Open Instant Replay management and settings popup (F9 default)
